name: Keyframe
description: Bézier curve point with two handles defining a Keyframe on an F-Curve

items.name: Free
items.description: Completely independent manually set handle

items.name: Aligned
items.description: Manually set handle with rotation locked together with its pair

items.name: Vector
items.description: Automatic handles that create straight lines

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Automatic handles that create smooth curves

items.name: Auto Clamped
items.description: Automatic handles that create smooth curves which only change direction at keyframes

items.name: Free
items.description: Completely independent manually set handle

items.name: Aligned
items.description: Manually set handle with rotation locked together with its pair

items.name: Vector
items.description: Automatic handles that create straight lines

items.name: Automatic
items.description: Automatic handles that create smooth curves

items.name: Auto Clamped
items.description: Automatic handles that create smooth curves which only change direction at keyframes

props.name: Interpolation
props.description: Interpolation method to use for segment of the F-Curve from this Keyframe until the next Keyframe

items.name: Constant
items.description: No interpolation, value of A gets held until B is encountered

items.name: Linear
items.description: Straight-line interpolation between A and B (i.e. no ease in/out)

items.name: Bézier
items.description: Smooth interpolation between A and B, with some control over curve shape

items.name: Sinusoidal
items.description: Sinusoidal easing (weakest, almost linear but with a slight curvature)

items.name: Quadratic
items.description: Quadratic easing

items.name: Cubic
items.description: Cubic easing

items.name: Quartic
items.description: Quartic easing

items.name: Quintic
items.description: Quintic easing

items.name: Exponential
items.description: Exponential easing (dramatic)

items.name: Circular
items.description: Circular easing (strongest and most dynamic)

items.name: Back
items.description: Cubic easing with overshoot and settle

items.name: Bounce
items.description: Exponentially decaying parabolic bounce, like when objects collide

items.name: Elastic
items.description: Exponentially decaying sine wave, like an elastic band

props.name: Type
props.description: Type of keyframe (for visual purposes only)

items.name: Keyframe
items.description: Normal keyframe, e.g. for key poses

items.name: Breakdown
items.description: A breakdown pose, e.g. for transitions between key poses

items.name: Moving Hold
items.description: A keyframe that is part of a moving hold

items.name: Extreme
items.description: An "extreme" pose, or some other purpose as needed

items.name: Jitter
items.description: A filler or baked keyframe for keying on ones, or some other purpose as needed

items.name: Generated
items.description: A key generated automatically by a tool, not manually created

props.name: Easing
props.description: Which ends of the segment between this and the next keyframe easing interpolation is applied to

items.name: Automatic Easing
items.description: Easing type is chosen automatically based on what the type of interpolation used (e.g. Ease In for transitional types, and Ease Out for dynamic effects)

items.name: Ease In
items.description: Only on the end closest to the next keyframe

items.name: Ease Out
items.description: Only on the end closest to the first keyframe

items.name: Ease In and Out
items.description: Segment between both keyframes

props.name: Amplitude
props.description: Amount to boost elastic bounces for 'elastic' easing

props.name: Period
props.description: Time between bounces for elastic easing

props.name: Left Handle
props.description: Coordinates of the left handle (before the control point)

props.name: Control Point
props.description: Coordinates of the control point. Note: Changing this value also updates the handles similar to using the graph editor transform operator

props.name: Right Handle
props.description: Coordinates of the right handle (after the control point)
